name: customer-logo-dots
title: Customer logo dots
description: Customer logo rendered as dots, with an arrow transition on hover or focus.
usage: The picture of a customer story card (`tone="onBlue"` on the blue card, `onWhite` on a white panel). Remote logos need CORS or a same-origin `resolveSrc`.
avoid: Logos in their own colors on a story card
A dot logo without a link around it

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
